note: Small wooded campground south of Salem, about 5 miles from the Current River (no water at the sites), with tent sites, a sleeper cabin and a store selling gas, ice, firewood and groceries; open to any camper, not only float customers. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $30 full-hookup RV sites (12, 50/30-amp, water+sewer), booked by phone, military 10% off; site is 5 miles from the Current River, so not waterfront stands. Cleared the unsourced ~May-Sep season (operator states none). Published name is Running River Campground.
flags: Price gate: $30/night full hookup (operator site, read 2026-11-08) - well under $50. Presence: own website with phone + Google 4.5 over 82 reviews. Public bookability: the site sells the 12 RV sites to anyone ('Book your stay today ... 12 RV sites offering full hookups'); nothing ties them to float customers.

NAME: the operator and Google publish 'Running River Campground'; the entry is named 'Running River Canoe Rental' (the operator's site lists a 'Running River Canoe Rental' float business separately under 'Explore'). Suggest renaming to Running River Campground.

Waterfront confirmed not waterfront: the operator says 'Located 5 miles from the Current River'; imagery shows the store at the pin and a gravel RV loop ~70-100 m SW of it on a forested ridge, no stream or pond near the pads. Pin (store) is ~100 m from the loop - within tolerance.

Season: the operator's site gives no season; the stored season (~May-Sep, 'Approximate') came from note prose with no source and is cleared. RV Life's 'Running River Canoe Rental' record (9512, 4*/$$) sits 24 km north near Salem and is probably the float outfitter, not this campground - the stored rating may describe that record.
